senses.def: That is both NP (solvable in polynomial time by a non-deterministic Turing machine) and NP-hard (such that any (other) NP problem can be reduced to it in polynomial time).
The state or condition of being NP-complete.
an agency that serves as the focal point for all Intelligence Community activities related to nonproliferation of weapons of mass destruction and their missile delivery systems
A person with no ability to think for themselves; a sheeple (originally referring to opponents of US President Donald Trump).
To act as an NPC (“non-player character”) in a game.
ex:
[in a deleted scene, one of the signs used by the homeless Q*bert gang reads as follows]
"will npc in fps 4 food!"
